name: Thick parallel vocal
desc: FET squeezed 7 – 10 dB and blended about 30 % under the dry vocal: thickness and punch, the dynamics stay

refs.why: Chiccarelli tucked a heavily squeezed parallel 1176 under the lead vocal
refs.source: Vintage King, Five Sounds with Joe Chiccarelli, 2022

notes: Slow-to-mid attack, fast-to-mid release as in the interview; mix 30 % stands for the parallel bus fader
